how: The verdicts of the 2026-11-12 morning probe of 44 sites from Reason's own browser, as reported to the fix that reads them (PR 'sign-in probe fixes'). This file records the verdict per site, not the probe's raw output: where a per-site status was not handed over, the line says only 'bot wall'. Nothing was done to get around a wall.
finding: Sites listed as walled answered the sign-in page with a bot wall (HTTP 403 or a challenge page that never clears). Spotify loads and takes the email, then answers "Something went wrong". Each line is a fact about 2026-11-12 only: src/sitefindings.js believes a probe wall for 14 days and then asks the site again.
read_by: src/sitefindings.js PROBE (test/signin-probe-1112.test.js checks the two agree).
also_found: Marriott: a footer "Facebook" link to its social page was read as a sign-in button (fixed: src/providerbutton.js).
Google: refuses Reason's browser after the email is typed (proved 2026-11-10); the Google button has not been pressed since #481. There is no working Google route in Reason's browser.
signin_status said "can sign in here" for DoorDash while every page answered 403 (fixed: the field was about the person being at the Mac; each site now carries a dated signin_here).
